title: Supply Gorge Crossing

serves.summary: The learner designs a bridge that carries a truck of a given weight across a gorge within a budget and tests it, practising engineering design against a requirement and a constraint.

request.objective: Design a bridge that meets a load requirement within a budget, and test it (3-5-ETS1)

problems.ask: Design a bridge that can carry the 12-ton truck across the gorge.

proofScene.lastTest: the truck reached the far bank

problems.ask: Design a bridge that can carry the truck across and stays within the budget.
problems.goal: The bridge holds the truck and costs at most $6.

problems.ask: A heavier truck is coming. Design a bridge that can carry it and stays within the budget.
problems.goal: The bridge holds the truck and costs at most $8.

problems.ask: There is no test drive this time. Design a bridge that can carry this truck and stays within the budget.
problems.goal: The bridge holds the truck and costs at most $7.
